result: Implemented focusa.mission_canvas.layout_memory.get as a bounded generated read operation. The API now requires exact Workstream authority and explicit profile/activity/viewport selectors, reads only the Workstream-partitioned canonical memory document, validates the Core-owned ProfileLayoutMemory identity/content, and returns the direct generated DTO. Desktop resolves the GET path from the generated operation registry, validates the exact authority/profile tuple and placement memory, rejects stale memory revisions, and never receives or composes a projection layout locally.

UI-001.decision: The generated registry-driven transport adapter is present on the integrated base and was extended without replacing its generated operation lookup, exact Workstream validation, or trusted renderer boundary. No separate checked-in UI-001 evidence artifact is available in this checkout.

UI-002.decision: The canonical DesktopContext Workstream binding is present and remains the sole source of exact Desktop authority; layout_memoryGet rejects missing or mismatched authority before HTTP.

presentation_contract.surface_kind: Focusa Desktop Mission Canvas Svelte GUI tab
presentation_contract.proof_class: generated transport/runtime integration with Core DTO validation, exact Workstream/profile binding, stale-memory watermark, and hostile response checks
omitted_contribution_reasons: layout_memory.get returns canonical placement memory and has no direct rendered contribution
absent contribution IDs are retained as memory data and never reserved as geometry or rendered as empty chrome
continuity_invariants: ScopeRef → ProjectRootKey → WorkstreamId → ContinuityId → AttachmentKey → SessionId/InstanceId → WorkspaceBindingId → RuntimeObjectRef → WorkSurfaceId remains exact and immutable.
Core owns Workstream partitioning, memory identity, placement validation, and persistence; Desktop consumes the generated DTO and does not infer profile, eligibility, or layout.
The generated transport owns operation ID/path/method and response validation; the trusted recursive canonical projection renderer remains untouched and remains the only layout renderer.
Foreign scope, foreign profile/activity/viewport, malformed memory, missing authority, and regressed memory revision fail closed without fallback data.

generated_contract.artifact_status: Generated operation registry, OpenAPI, TypeScript client, validators, capability snapshot, and UI bindings passed parity/determinism; no generated contract, task packet/index, graph, plan, or orchestration artifact was edited.

implementation: The API read path requires mission_canvas:read, parses and validates the generated Workstream query, extracts the authenticated actor/authority WorkstreamContext, requires profile_id/activity_mode_id/viewport_class selectors, and reads the exact Workstream-partitioned memory document keyed by the canonical profile tuple.

The reusable Core validator checks exact full authority equality, profile/activity/viewport identity, canonical memory_id, idempotency metadata, placement spans/duplicates, and absent-contribution IDs before the DTO can leave the API. The route returns direct ProfileLayoutMemory rather than StoredDocument or a route-local wrapper.

The Desktop transport keeps operation metadata generated, validates the selector request before HTTP, sends only exact authority and selectors, validates nested placement memory, checks canonical memory identity, and maintains a per-authority/profile/activity/viewport memory revision watermark.

The hostile Desktop consumer exercises the generated client method, exact GET/query/header transport, direct DTO shape, missing selectors/authority, foreign Workstream and Attachment, foreign profile, malformed wrapper/placement, stale revision, denied permission/capability, unavailable operation, and no-local-composition behavior. Existing trusted recursive projection rendering is not changed or bypassed.

negative_cases.foreign_workstream: The API reads only the exact Workstream partition and Core validation rejects a payload whose Workstream/Attachment differs; Desktop rejects foreign_profile_memory_scope before adoption.
negative_cases.missing_authority: Desktop rejects a request without generated Workstream identity before HTTP; the API requires actor and authority headers and Core rejects orphan WorkSurface authority.
negative_cases.foreign_profile_or_selector: The response profile_id, activity_mode_id, and viewport_class must equal the generated request selectors; canonical memory_id must match the same tuple.
negative_cases.stale_revision: Desktop retains a per-exact-authority memory_revision watermark and rejects a structurally valid regressed memory with stale_profile_memory_revision. This operation has no If-Match/cursor requirement in the generated descriptor.
negative_cases.unavailable_capability: The operation has no separate generated capability requirement; Desktop does not mint one. An unavailable-capability ToolResult response is surfaced as a typed transport failure.
negative_cases.permission_denied: The generated operation declares mission_canvas:read; a hostile 403 is surfaced without local memory fallback.
negative_cases.ineligible_or_empty_contribution: Absent contribution IDs remain canonical memory data only; no optional contribution, panel, heading, border, layout node, or substitute is fabricated.
negative_cases.invalid_response: Generated structural validation plus exact authority, memory ID, revision, timestamp, placement, duplicate, and absent-ID validation reject wrappers, malformed placements, foreign data, and malformed memory.
negative_cases.local_inference: Desktop sends no layout_tree, eligible_contributions, candidate registry, or renderer data and performs no profile/eligibility/layout resolution. Canonical recursive projection rendering remains owned by the existing trusted renderer registry.
